content: I note that Ines is pushing to settle a host soon, but I'm not ready to volunteer yet.
I note Ines's question but cannot engage until Friday.
I'm aware Ines asked who will host, but I hope someone else offers.
I remember that I have the biggest kitchen but my night shifts might make hosting difficult.
Bea might host if her schedule allows, so I don't need to jump in yet.
I'll wait until tomorrow morning to see if Bea responds; if not, I'll offer to host.
I've decided to host since no one else has stepped up and it's already past the morning I planned to wait.
